PURPOSE: Brokered external-tool execution: connected-account object model, auth-delegation flow (hosted Connect Link + callback verifier), dispatch-time execution-identity resolution, credential lifecycle (connect/refresh/disconnect/revoke), tool schemas, execution receipts. Re-derive as PING-native Delegated Execution Credential for capability-kernel / WorkerAdapter direction.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: Delegated Execution Credential: {id, owner_user_id, provider (toolkit slug), auth_scheme, credential_handle (opaque, write-once, read-never), provider_identity (read-only displayName), status (INITIATED|ACTIVE|EXPIRED|INACTIVE|REVOKED), bound_tool_scopes, allowed_dispatchers (ACL), refresh_policy}. Lets a worker execute a third-party action on a human's behalf where: the worker references the handle but can never read the secret; identity resolves server-side at dispatch from trusted dispatcher context, never from worker arguments; the credential has a state machine with proactive refresh and signed expiry notification; it binds capability grants; every use emits an execution receipt (log_id-equivalent) with the full attribution chain.
